name: world-cup-forecast-site
description: World Cup forecast website with automatic data sync.

scripts.check: node --check app.js && node --check server.js && node --check api/site-data.js && node --check scripts/sync-data.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('data/site-data.json','utf8')); JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('vercel.json','utf8')); console.log('data ok')"
